investigation.title: Burning and Suppression of Solids–II  (BASS-II) Summary Report
investigation.summary: The Burning and Suppression of Solids-II (BASS-II) investigation examined the combustion and extinction characteristics of solid polymethylmethacrylate (PMMA) slabs and cylindrical rods in the Microgravity Science Glovebox (MSG) aboard the International Space Station (ISS). Low-speed forced airflows in microgravity isolate convective and radiative extinction limits without buoyancy.
investigation.objectives: Evaluate flame spread rate over thick and thin solid fuels, determine low-flow flammability boundaries, and assess fire suppression effectiveness in microgravity.
investigation.apparatus_description: Small Flow Duct mounted inside the Microgravity Science Glovebox (MSG) aboard the ISS.
